item.title: System Geometries and Transit / Eclipse Probabilities
DEATHSTAR: A system for confirming planets and identifying false positive signals in TESS data using ground-based time domain surveys

notes: Let's begin with the dream of leaving our solar system, inspired by stories like Contact, to face the vast distances between stars.
Building on that scale, we now look even further out to travel between entire galaxies, a task requiring millions of years with current physics.
Stepping up a level, we shift from just moving through space to studying how planets physically interact with their host stars across different wavelengths.
With that in hand, we examine specific system geometries where long-period orbits reveal stable environments unlike the extreme heat of hot Jupiters.
Finally, we apply this knowledge to a new verification system that filters false signals to confirm real planets hiding among the data.
